page.overview:
Who is Scott and Max?

Scott and Max are the two fighters that appear in the opening of Street Fighter II fighting in front of a crowd. In the attract sequence, the former defeats the latter by a single straight punch to the face before the game goes to the title screen. This would later be referenced in Street Fighter 6.

In Street Fighter V, Scott can be seen in the Ring of Arcade stage background. He also appears in the World Tour mode in Street Fighter 6.

Max also appears in Street Fighter V in A Shadow Falls, where he faces Alex in a CWA match and is defeated. He can also be seen in the background in the High Roller Casino and Ring of Arcade stages. He also appears in the World Tour mode of Street Fighter 6.
